finalText:
Implemented `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon`.

Changes:
- `src/db.ts`: added `withTransaction` helper (commit/rollback).
- `src/repositories/orderRepository.ts`: `applyCoupon` (order update) + `transaction`.
- `src/repositories/couponRepository.ts`: `recordRedemption` + `incrementUsedCount`.
- `src/services/orderService.ts`: `applyCoupon` with all REQ checks in the specified order, discount math, and atomic write via one transaction.
- `src/routes/orders.ts` + `src/app.ts`: route registration and wiring.
- `tests/applyCoupon.test.ts`: new tests covering AC-01..AC-10 and all error codes.

`npm run build` and `npm test` (24 tests) pass.
